response.answer: Studies show that including external costs in pricing can influence consumer choices towards more sustainable options, with significant impacts noted in organic food and sustainability labeling. Surveys in the Netherlands and Denmark reveal that presentation formats significantly affect consumer attitudes. True pricing enhances consumer trust and value perception.
